epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子、炸「雞」三文治和越南「鮎魚」;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「後院」,發現美味的素壽司、開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食: 素海鮮、檸檬汁「海鮮」冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅。之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東—孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一—雲南。 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島—一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind - staying alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千尺高空探索西開普省驚人的海岸線、雄偉的山脈和豐富多樣的大都會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌。從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: F-14雄猫战斗机于1986年的电影《壮志凌云》中亮相大银幕,并参加了锡德拉湾事件、冷战对抗和两伊战争等重大军事冲突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The F-14 Tomcat fighter jet hit the big screen in 1986s Top Gun and flew in major military conflicts like the Gulf of Sidra incident, Cold War confrontations and the Iran-Iraq War.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索潘塔納爾濕地400平方英裡的地區,這裡由美洲豹統治,生命都遵循著水的季節節奏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 布萊德彼特:突破好萊塢
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 他可能是最性感的好萊塢演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道.布萊德彼特.整個好萊塢首屈一指的人物之一.一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt. One of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色.他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽.而我們都知道他......是 湯姆漢克斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as 『America’s Nice Guy』, 』The Everyman』 and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him... as Tom Hanks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #2

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 森美拉發掘印度美食的起源.她尋找獨家和可靠的地方,說服廚師分享部分秘密,與街頭小販一起煮食,並浪蕩到古老的印度香料市場,帶你一瞥印度豐富的烹飪傳統,

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌.他的名字依舊令人尊敬.聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called 「bubble feeding」 to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the remarkable journey of one of boxing’s most unstoppable forces. Manny Pacquiao’s legacy will forever be remembered for the change accomplished inside and outside the ring...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 森美拉發掘印度美食的起源.她尋找獨家和可靠的地方,說服廚師分享部分秘密,與街頭小販一起煮食,並浪蕩到古老的印度香料市場,帶你一瞥印度豐富的烹飪傳統,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Samira convinces chefs to part with their secrets, cooks with street vendors and wanders into ancient spice markets to give you a peek into India’s rich culinary heritage.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事.接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably - launching their fishing boat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison d』être. The police forces』 special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000臺風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好萊塢以鐵蝴蝶聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Best known in Hollywood as 「The Iron Butterfly」 - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #2

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jackie Chan plays a dual role as twins separated at birth who grow up and cross paths. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation. Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From armored bodies, to feisty attitudes, to outright deception… there is only one rule to defense: do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Home to an extraordinary biodiversity, the jungles of Asia are among the most ancient rainforests on Earth – they are also among the planet’s most rapidly disappearing habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation. Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: With little evidence to guide them, the SVU steps in when a woman undergoing psychedelic-assisted therapy recovers a buried memory of assault. Curry starts a new position at SVU.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班森震驚地發現臥底警探維拉斯科竟處於一場性販運瓦解行動的核心.隨著更多女性被偷運進城,一名獲救的受害者懇求 SVU 營救她的妹妹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Benson is shocked to find undercover Det. Velasco at the center of a sex trafficking bust. When more women are smuggled into the city, a rescued victim begs SVU to help save her sister.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 飯店內的一起神秘死亡案件將小隊帶入職業格鬥的世界.班森試圖說服一名受害者為了朋友挺身而出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mysterious death in a hotel leads the squad into the world of professional fighting. Benson tries to convince a victim to come forward for the sake of his friend.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名昏迷受傷的青少年被遺棄在醫院外,迫使 SVU 追查遺棄她的人.班森在接受反詰問的壓力下選擇守住受害者的秘密,因而面臨嚴重後果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unconscious and injured teen abandoned outside a hospital sends the SVU on a search for the people who left her there. Benson faces serious consequences when she chooses to protect a victim’s secret under the pressure of cross examination.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在刑事司法系統中,尤其罪無可恕的被公認為性犯罪.在紐約市,專門調查這些惡極大罪的警探就是特案組的成員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the criminal justice system, sexually based crimes are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of the Special Victims Unit.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 21
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在刑事司法系統中,尤其罪無可恕的被公認為性犯罪.在紐約市,專門調查這些惡極大罪的警探就是特案組的成員.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小隊在調查一名強姦嫌疑犯並試圖保護關鍵證人時,危險接踵而至.新任警探長對班森(Benson)展開考驗.休班中的芬(Fin)試圖阻止一場正在發生的襲擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danger swirls around the squad as they investigate a suspect for rape and try to protect their key witness. A new chief of detectives puts Benson to the test. An off-duty Fin tries to stop an assault in progress.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名精英社交俱樂部的成員遭到襲擊時,儘管俱樂部有嚴格的保密規定,卡瑞西(Carisi)仍必須說服證人出面指證.泰南(Tynan)警長向班森提供額外協助.維拉斯科(Velasco)面臨一個意外的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a member of an elite social club is assaulted, Carisi must convince witnesses to come forward despite the club’s strict confidentiality rules. Chief Tynan offers Benson some extra help. Velasco is confronted with a surprising opportunity.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布魯諾(Bruno)懷疑有人安置炸彈是為了摧毀一起強姦案的 DNA 證據.班森接手了一起與爆炸案有關的謀殺調查.格里芬(Griffin)體會到辦理特別受害者小組(SVU)案件時令人沮喪的挫折感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruno suspects a bomb was planted to destroy DNA evidence in a rape case. Benson takes on a murder investigation connected to the bombing. Griffin experiences the frustrating setbacks of working an SVU case.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名青少女因流產而面臨生命危險時,SVU 必須揭開網路編造的謊言網以辨認嫌疑人.羅林斯(Rollins)審慎評估她的職業選擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a tween suffers a life-threatening miscarriage, the SVU must unravel a web of online fabrications to identify a suspect. Rollins carefully weighs her career options.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名即將臨盆的孕婦遭到綁架,羅林斯與庫瑞(Curry)向她的陪產員尋求事件經過.卡瑞西試圖在陪審團面前取得被告的招供.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a woman in active labor is abducted, Rollins and Curry look to her doula for an account of events. Carisi tries to get a confession in front of the jury.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小隊調查一起發生在家庭派對上的襲擊案,但現場無人能辨認攻擊者.當兩名嫌疑人被拘留審訊時,羅林斯藉機教唆他們反目成仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The squad investigates an assault at a house party where no one can identify the assailant. When two suspects are detained for questioning, Rollins takes the chance to turn one against the other.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名知名作家扭曲了一起嚴重犯罪的細節時,SVU 必須從幻想中辨別事實.芬在工作上度過了挑戰重重的一天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The SVU must determine fact from fantasy when a famous author twists the details of a serious crime. Fin has a challenging day at work.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名男子聲稱其女友遭到綁架,布魯諾調查其說詞中的漏洞.泰南在一次意見分歧後對班森嚴加責難.格里芬必須在證人席上為自己的偵查工作辯護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a man claims his girlfriend was kidnapped, Bruno investigates the holes in his story. Tynan comes down hard on Benson after a disagreement. Griffin must defend his policework on the stand.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對謀殺嫌疑人的追捕揭開了一起具有震驚法律與倫理影響的犯罪.布魯諾在突襲嫌疑人住所時必須保護他的隊員.當布萊迪(Brady)的審訊手段損害案件時,卡瑞西與普萊斯(Price)在法庭上聯手應對.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hunt for a murder suspect uncovers a crime with shocking legal and ethical implications. Bruno must protect his squad during a raid on a suspect’s home. Carisi and Price team up in court when Brady’s interrogation tactics undermine the case.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起針對德高望重法官的暗殺企圖,與上傳到 SVU 檢舉熱線的匿名影片有關.羅林斯試圖幫助一名受害者接受並面對其曾遭虐待的事實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An attempt on a respected judge’s life is connected to an anonymous video posted to the SVU tip line. Rollins tries to help a victim come to terms with their abuse.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 庫瑞的兒子在二手店淘到的舊卡帶中發現了令人不安的內容,她與班森隨即對一起數十年前的失蹤案展開調查.格里芬得知了關於他父親的驚人傳聞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Curry’s son finds a disturbing cassette tape in a thrift store haul, she and Benson must investigate a decades-old missing persons case. Griffin learns a disturbing rumor about his father.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場對謀殺嫌疑人的追緝揭示了其背後震驚的法律與倫理糾葛.布魯諾在對嫌疑人住處進行搜查時必須全力保護小隊成員.卡瑞西與普萊斯在法庭上並肩作戰,應對因布萊迪審訊方式而產生的案件紕漏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hunt for a murder suspect uncovers a crime with shocking legal and ethical implications. Bruno must protect his squad during a raid on a suspect’s home. Carisi and Price team up in court when Brady’s interrogation tactics undermine the case.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名從險境中獲救的少年哀求班森幫助她與父親團聚.卡瑞西與 CJ 針對寄養系統在缺乏足夠證據下拆散家庭的行為提出質疑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A teenager rescued from a dangerous situation begs Benson to help reunite her with her father. Carisi and CJ take the foster care system to task for separating families without sufficient proof.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一家人的嬰兒監視器接收到不明頻率,進而發現一名男童正身陷險境.格里芬採取極端手段試圖尋找男孩的下落.羅林斯發現自己與一名掠奪者單獨相處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A family discovers a young boy in grave danger when their baby monitor picks up a rogue frequency. Griffin goes to extremes to find the boy’s location. Rollins finds herself alone with a predator.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 17

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 18

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mysterious death in a hotel leads the squad into the world of professional fighting. Benson tries to convince a victim to come forward for the sake of his friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unconscious and injured teen abandoned outside a hospital sends the SVU on a search for the people who left her there. Benson faces serious consequences when she chooses to protect a victim’s secret under the pressure of cross examination.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a woman in active labor is abducted, Rollins and Curry look to her doula for an account of events. Carisi tries to get a confession in front of the jury.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The squad investigates an assault at a house party where no one can identify the assailant. When two suspects are detained for questioning, Rollins takes the chance to turn one against the other.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Diane has to decide on the firms future, after losing two leading lawyers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 律師樓迎來新人,包括瑪莉莎和卡文.而瑪莉莎發現自己仿如身處一個臨時法庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New associates come to the office, including Marissa and Carmen. Marissa finds herself in an improvised court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米卡斯曼為她的偶像,千萬富翁華特佩奇擔任臨時保姆.初時發展很好,直到他的求愛被拒,他的企圖很快就從不恰當變成致命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Kassman takes on a temporary job as a nanny for her idol, multimillionnaire Walter Page. Things start off great but when his advances get rejected, his intentions quickly go from inappropriate to deadly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍犯罪調查局在脅持人質事件中尋找失蹤的臥底探員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS searches for a missing undercover agent in the midst of an active hostage situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凡斯準備主持與委內瑞拉的外交會談,小隊被委派調查他一名線人的屍體.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Vance prepares to host diplomatic talks with Venezuela, the team is called in to investigate the dead body of one of his inside men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名在萬聖節前夕回家的中尉發現家裡正為別人舉辦驚喜派對,海軍犯罪調查局奉命調查.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS is called in to investigate when a lieutenant returns home on Halloween Eve to find a surprise party being thrown for someone else at his home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 收到多個地點可能導致災難性戰爭的致命威脅情報後,海軍犯罪調查局奉命嘗試解除危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After receiving intelligence on deadly threats to multiple locations that could lead to a catastrophic war, NCIS is called in to try to neutralize the danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍犯罪調查局與中央情報局合作查出前間諜畢拿上尉守著哪些秘密,他已經是個患有癡呆症的老人了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS works with the CIA to discover what secrets are being kept by Captain Butler, an elderly former spy with dementia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名高級國防承包商的家遭到襲擊後,麗特被派去保護他的妻子,事情變得緊張起來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Things become tense when Knight is assigned to protect his wife after the home of a high-level defense contractor is attacked.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 托利斯從一名機密線人得知一些有被出售風險的絕密海軍資訊情報.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Torres receives intel from a confidential informant regarding top secret naval information thats at risk of being sold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍犯罪調查局調查一宗有關汽車自航的凶案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS investigates a murder related to a car that begins driving on its own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 令人震驚的爆料威脅到一名有功績的海軍陸戰隊隊員的聖誕節,海軍犯罪調查局必須揭開真相並施行一個節日奇蹟--趕在書本上架將英雄的事績變成節日災難前.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a shocking tell-all threatens to ruin Christmas for a decorated Marine, NCIS must unwrap the truth and deliver a holiday miracle -- before the book hits shelves and turns a heros legacy into a holiday disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍犯罪調查局得知帕加最喜歡的麵包店老闆正被勒索,他們計劃拯救她.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After NCIS learns that the owner of Parkers favorite bakery is being blackmailed, they hatch a plan to save her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍犯罪調查局為兩名成員安排一場假婚禮以圖剷除黑幫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS stages a fake wedding for two of its own in an attempt to take down the mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍犯罪調查局調查嘉倩的一名法醫學家中毒身亡案.另外,麥之就其書中的內容接受五角大樓的盤問.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS investigates the fatal poisoning of one of Kasies forensic scientists. Meanwhile, McGee is questioned by the Pentagon regarding the contents of his book.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍罪案調查局調查一宗海軍中尉在血庫死亡的案件.另外,麥之需要小隊幫他雙胞胎的學校捐款活動籌款.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy lieutenant found dead at a blood donation bank. Also, McGee needs help from the team to raise money for his twins’ school fundraiser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 托利斯收到占美女兒的短信,說她在海軍圖書館附近發現了大量現金,小隊一起展開調查.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Torres receives a text from Jimmy’s daughter who has discovered a large sum of money near the naval library, the team works together to investigate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名海軍中尉的死亡被揭發與特務梳也(星荷茲飾)有關,托利斯和麗特發現一宗與豪門有關的謀殺案.另外,帕加發現母親的死與莉莉之間有著驚人的關聯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Navy Lieutenant’s death reveals ties to Special Agent Sawyer (Zane Holtz), Torres and Knight uncover a murder linked to a wealthy family. Meanwhile, Parker discovers a shocking connection between his mother’s death and Lily.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名海軍中尉的死亡被揭發與特務梳也(星荷茲飾)有關,托利斯和麗特發現一宗與豪門有關的謀殺案.另外,帕加發現母親的死與莉莉之間有著驚人的關聯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Navy Lieutenant’s death reveals ties to Special Agent Sawyer (Zane Holtz), Torres and Knight uncover a murder linked to a wealthy family. Meanwhile, Parker discovers a shocking connection between his mother’s death and Lily.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍罪案調查局接到電話調查一名縱火疑犯的動機,讓一場女孩之夜發生意想不到的轉折.另外,托利斯也努力尋找工作與生活的平衡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A girls’ night out takes an unexpected turn when NCIS is called to investigate the motive of a possible arsonist. Also, Torres struggles to find work/life balance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍罪案調查局逮捕綽號詩人的殺手後,小隊爭分奪秒找出是誰下令暗殺海軍作戰部長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After NCIS captures the hitman known as The Poet, the team races to uncover who ordered the assassination of a Navy Chief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名退伍軍人被發現在華盛頓特區一家旅館的房間被殺害,海軍罪案調查局追蹤到一名疑犯,他只肯與森漢拿交談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a trio of combat vets are found murdered in a D.C. motel room, NCIS tracks down a suspect who refuses to talk to anyone but Sam Hanna.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥之調查副局長貪污案,他的職業生涯和信譽岌岌可危.另外,托利斯和麗特收到一些驚喜消息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: McGees career and credibility are on the line when he investigates the deputy director for corruption. Also, Torres and Knight receive some surprising news.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍罪案調查局調查力殺士販毒集團與帕加的宿敵- 黑幫老大卡拿馬連奴之間的危險聯繫,小隊發現一個涉及被盜核燃料的高風險陰謀.時日無多,帕加被逼形成一個不安的聯盟,那可能會決定行動的命運-以及他的未來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As NCIS investigates a dangerous connection between the Nexus cartel and Parkers longtime nemesis, mob boss Carla Marino, the team uncovers a high-stakes plot involving stolen nuclear material. With time running out, Parker is forced into an uneasy

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Torres receives intel from a confidential informant regarding top secret naval information thats at risk of being sold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的。研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞邁出了重要的一步,在桑布魯區中心地段開設第一個社區經營的犀牛保育區。非法武裝偷獵團對肯尼亞犀牛的威脅達到40年來最高,這讓保育區更顯重要。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kenya takes a major step with the opening of its first community-run rhino sanctuary in the heart of Samburu territory. The threat to Kenya’s rhinos from armed, illegal poaching gangs is the highest its been in 40 years, which makes the sanctuary vital.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化。這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Millions of years ago, castaway creatures were stranded on the rugged shores of Madagascar. Left to evolve on their own, they’ve found a way to perfectly adapt to their tropical climate. Now, see what life is like for a family of ring-tailed lemurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這島是狐猴的天地。狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小、顏色和形狀都有。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The island is the land of Lemurs. Lemurs are fascinating arboreal primitive primates of Madagascar represented in all sizes, colors, and shapes from the largest Indri to the tiny mouse lemur.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於南非的霍格斯巴克,有兩種迷人的靈長類動物棲居其中: 長尾猴和開普鸚鵡。窺探牠們如何克服棲息地日益萎縮的困境,並充分利用機會,穿越城鎮尋找食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hogsback, South Africa, is home to two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots. See how they overcome habit loss, travel across town for food, and make the most of a difficult situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉。但繁華背後卻有一個問題——牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bambelela Troop is a successful and gregarious troop of Chacma Baboons that live in a pristine valley in the Waterberg Mountains of South Africa. But they have a problem—they’re not the only baboons around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獅尾狒是一種稀有的猴子,只棲居於埃塞俄比亞塞米恩山脈之中,他們富有魅力,愛發出聲音,並經常處於熱情和對抗之間。觀察牠們如何面對棲息地萎縮的挑戰——以及彼此之間的鬥爭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They’re charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南非的荒野,近距離觀察這個大陸最容易被誤解的靈長類動物之一。跟人類一樣,這些靈長類動物具有獨特的個性,與家人和朋友都有著強烈的聯繫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent’s most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟。它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌。從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於尚比亞盧薩卡附近的李利爾大象幼兒園是四隻大象孤兒的家園。兩頭最年長的分別是四歲的墨蘇路利和贊比茲,牠們只有幾個月大的時候就開始住在那裡。這些吵鬧的嬰兒不再適合住在託兒所,是時候搬到大學校了。在兩百英里外,位於卡富埃國家公園的中心地帶,是大象的天堂 - 鳳凰營,該項目的釋放設施,年長的孤兒已經適應了野外生活。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lilayi Elephant Nursery near Lusaka in Zambia is home to four orphan elephants. The two oldest, four-year- olds Musolole and Zambezi, have been here since they were just a few months old. These boisterous babies are out-growing the nursery and it’s time to move to big school. Two hundred miles away, in the heart of Kafue National Park, lies elephant heaven - Camp Phoenix, the project’s release facility, where older orphans are already adapting to life in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kasanka National Park in Zambia is home to an unusual species of baboon. Kinda baboons have turned their backs on the aggressive displays of dominance usually associated with these large monkeys and lead altogether more peaceful lives. Living alongside one troop is a dedicated team of researchers whose mission it is to uncover these baboons’ secrets and understand what makes them who they are.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為你介紹一隻非常特別的猴子 - 麥當娜。她是有史以來第一隻從出生到成年直至現在都在學習的金達狒狒,關鍵的是,她正在尋找伴侶。金達狒狒最近才被確定為一個物種,牠們鮮為人知亦不為人理解。但麥當娜正在幫助改變這情況。她可能抓住解開金達狒狒獨特兩性關係秘密的關鍵。這些狒狒獨一無二。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet Madonna, a very special monkey. She’s the first Kinda baboon ever to be studied from birth to adulthood and now, critically, she’s looking for a mate. Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda’s unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力: 群體的生存。但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事。一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲。一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶。一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠。這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.programme_title_tc: 巨象同盟: 長牙兄弟情
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象: 克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃。深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world’s largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」。本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the ‘arribada’, or ‘arrival’. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚、虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅。讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿、怪誕的生存策略。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力: 群體的生存。但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frog’s eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞的捕獲隊伍前往索馬里邊境捕獲50隻被稱為亨氏牛羚的珍稀瀕危羚羊。在過去十年中,亨氏牛羚的數量一直急劇下降,保育組織知道通過捕獲並將它們置於受保護的零捕獵者保育區,有助數量回升。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capture teams from Kenya head to Somali border to capture 50 rare and endangered antelope called a hirola. The hirola numbers have been plummeting over the last decade, and conservation groups know that by capturing and placing them into a protected predator-free conservancy they will rebound.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鵝聚集在水邊,準備在岸上進行危險的旅程。面對前路的險途,數量多比較安全。這些小企鵝有著重要的任務,繁殖的時候到了,牠們必須在雌性到來前找到一個洞穴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭的西岸不像世上任何地方。從冰川覆蓋的山脈到原始雨林,再到嚴酷的寒冷海域,壯麗景致令人難以置信。這片與世隔絕幾乎未被觸及的桃花園,隱藏著許多土生的動物。進化的漂流者,每一個都是罕見的生態瑰寶。從啄羊鸚鵡和害羞的企鵝到哺乳類般的鷸鴕和古老的鰻魚,為了於這種條件下生存,這裡的野生動物必須堅強,狡猾和足智多謀。沿著西岸的旅程讓你窺見這片美地,以及生活在這裡的野生動物的考驗和磨難。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭有兩個野生堡壘保護脆弱的土生動物: 一個是受到鹽水護城河保護的偏遠島嶼,另一個是被防捕食者屏障包圍的山頂城堡。這是這些精緻的庇護所和在其中茁壯成長的動物的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光。牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖。但因惡劣的地形、無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難。只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名。尤以不會飛的鳥類、古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界。這裡有微型的怪物、小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命。每個獵人也是獵物﹐永遠需要努力生存。走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活。從巨型肉食蜈蚣和夜行蟋蟀到捕魚蛛和使用絲質陷阱的發光蠕蟲。奇怪而奇妙,這些無名英雄是野性紐西蘭最令人毛骨悚然的爬行類。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道。在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅。就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡。但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種。這些主要被稱為牲畜、負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered “pests.” But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they’re not welcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用。這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因。保護族群才能賴以生存。對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it’s the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕。冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配。一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒。大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子。三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季。跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存。被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己。馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里。每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜。看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母。為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕。冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配。一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒。大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子。三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季。跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象傳奇有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在整個非洲,97%的黑犀牛因其角而被殺死.1997年,該物種在尚比亞被宣布正式絕種.但現在,由於雄心勃勃的重新引入計劃,牠們又回來了.偷獵並沒有消失 - 牠們的角在亞洲醫藥中仍然很珍貴.但一個專責小組正在努力保護牠們的安全.這是保育的前線 - 但它前所未有地困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away – their horns are still...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現代動物始祖演化出的第一個感官是化學感官:牠們能夠檢測環境中的化學物質.這有助動物始祖尋找獵物和配偶,並從遠處感知逐漸靠近的捕食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animals environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.
