epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視覺是最令人驚嘆的感官,為物種帶來無窮的適應能力.不同動物的眼睛賦予牠們截然不同的視覺,在某些情況下甚至讓人「眼界大開」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處非洲南部海岸的阿爾哥亞灣,是該大陸唯一的企鵝避難所.跟企鵝一起求生,牠們勇於接受難以容忍的因素,以建立一個不可能的海洋社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and host...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹.這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀.在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所.善於交際的織布鳥,綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器,枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體,以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在整個非洲,97%的黑犀牛因其角而被殺死.1997年,該物種在尚比亞被宣布正式絕種.但現在,由於雄心勃勃的重新引入計劃,牠們又回來了.偷獵並沒有消失 - 牠們的角在亞洲醫藥中仍然很珍貴.但一個專責小組正在努力保護牠們的安全.這是保育的前線 - 但它前所未有地困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away – their horns are still...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一隻雞穿梭整個美國,並到英國拜訪一個棲居於花園的老鼠家族.正所謂以毒攻毒,見證人們如何在蜘蛛的幫助下克服蜘蛛恐懼症,與守護著地球上最後兩隻北部白犀牛的志願者同行,並為更多跨物種的友情而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spiders help, trek with the guardian of Earths last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解鸚鵡和鴨嘴獸如何讓人發展出新事業,並窺視一個讓人類和大象終身相伴的共同創傷.本集還會拜訪35歲的火雞兀鷹喬治,並見證一場與袋鼠的道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探塔斯馬尼亞惡魔的溫柔一面,與一隻具冒險精神的海龜相遇,並與小鹿一起享受家庭聚餐.與800公斤的公牛斯普德踢足球,了解貓頭鷹迪格在保育者尼格爾的癌症治療期間,如何為他帶來安慰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Tasmanian devils softer side, meet a pioneering sea turtle, and enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer. Play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull and learn how Digger the owl soothed conservationist Nigel during his cancer treatment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起見證南極洲的巴布亞企鵝用一塊石頭表示愛意,走訪馬達加斯加看看狐猴如何利用有毒的千足蟲來擊退害蟲.齊來跟紅鸛學習化妝技巧,並看看蜜蜂獾展示開鎖技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來到在伯利茲的「海灘銀行」,見證寄居蟹有序排隊,以我們最歷史悠久的貨幣--貝殼進行交易.然後走訪塞內加爾,探望黑猩猩和他的寵物麝貓.見證一隻水獺如何以「人質」換來免費午餐,並到雨林中與切葉蟻們的一起收割.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimps pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了對抗溫室效應,女科學家顏欣培育出超級橡膠種子,前往一個荒島進行種植,希望將那裡改變為一片欣欣向榮的新土地。然而,她的前夫決定在這趟危險的旅程中保護她,與她結伴同行。抵達後,他們面臨接連不斷的衝突,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名持槍劫匪搶劫了一批正在運送的新發行貨幣,刑警常勇奉命展開調查。隨著線索逐漸浮現,常勇成功擊斃一名劫匪。然而,其他兩名劫匪不甘就此罷手,乘亂密謀搶劫金廠的黃金。常勇憑藉精密的部署,成功粉碎了他們的計..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed in a tragic incident during their visit to the Middle East. He is sent to a prison where he meets a Muslim inmate who helps him plan for a prison escape to prove his innocence. When his friend suddenly dies, can Frank successfully escape and seek justice for himself?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退役軍人吳巍和臥底刑警高天明帶領特別行動小組勇闖近曼谷的孤島,從暴徒手中救出人質。但在完成任務並準備離島之際,吳巍發現自己的女兒被對方脅持。為救女兒及將犯罪分子繩之以法,吳巍和高天明重回危險境地,與暴..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This programme finds Dr. Matt battling to fix a greyhound's broken leg to get it back on the track. But down on the farm Matt finds the old-fashioned way is best when it comes to finding out if a cow is pregnant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series.  Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie.  High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to  Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series.  Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie.  High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: First Contact
epg.episode_synopsis_en: First Contact

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的。研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞邁出了重要的一步,在桑布魯區中心地段開設第一個社區經營的犀牛保育區。非法武裝偷獵團對肯尼亞犀牛的威脅達到40年來最高,這讓保育區更顯重要。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kenya takes a major step with the opening of its first community-run rhino sanctuary in the heart of Samburu territory. The threat to Kenya’s rhinos from armed, illegal poaching gangs is the highest its been in 40 years, which makes the sanctuary vital.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化。這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Millions of years ago, castaway creatures were stranded on the rugged shores of Madagascar. Left to evolve on their own, they’ve found a way to perfectly adapt to their tropical climate. Now, see what life is like for a family of ring-tailed lemurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這島是狐猴的天地。狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小、顏色和形狀都有。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The island is the land of Lemurs. Lemurs are fascinating arboreal primitive primates of Madagascar represented in all sizes, colors, and shapes from the largest Indri to the tiny mouse lemur.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於南非的霍格斯巴克,有兩種迷人的靈長類動物棲居其中: 長尾猴和開普鸚鵡。窺探牠們如何克服棲息地日益萎縮的困境,並充分利用機會,穿越城鎮尋找食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hogsback, South Africa, is home to two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots. See how they overcome habit loss, travel across town for food, and make the most of a difficult situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉。但繁華背後卻有一個問題——牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bambelela Troop is a successful and gregarious troop of Chacma Baboons that live in a pristine valley in the Waterberg Mountains of South Africa. But they have a problem—they’re not the only baboons around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獅尾狒是一種稀有的猴子,只棲居於埃塞俄比亞塞米恩山脈之中,他們富有魅力,愛發出聲音,並經常處於熱情和對抗之間。觀察牠們如何面對棲息地萎縮的挑戰——以及彼此之間的鬥爭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They’re charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南非的荒野,近距離觀察這個大陸最容易被誤解的靈長類動物之一。跟人類一樣,這些靈長類動物具有獨特的個性,與家人和朋友都有著強烈的聯繫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent’s most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟。它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌。從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於尚比亞盧薩卡附近的李利爾大象幼兒園是四隻大象孤兒的家園。兩頭最年長的分別是四歲的墨蘇路利和贊比茲,牠們只有幾個月大的時候就開始住在那裡。這些吵鬧的嬰兒不再適合住在託兒所,是時候搬到大學校了。在兩百英里外,位於卡富埃國家公園的中心地帶,是大象的天堂 - 鳳凰營,該項目的釋放設施,年長的孤兒已經適應了野外生活。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lilayi Elephant Nursery near Lusaka in Zambia is home to four orphan elephants. The two oldest, four-year- olds Musolole and Zambezi, have been here since they were just a few months old. These boisterous babies are out-growing the nursery and it’s time to move to big school. Two hundred miles away, in the heart of Kafue National Park, lies elephant heaven - Camp Phoenix, the project’s release facility, where older orphans are already adapting to life in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kasanka National Park in Zambia is home to an unusual species of baboon. Kinda baboons have turned their backs on the aggressive displays of dominance usually associated with these large monkeys and lead altogether more peaceful lives. Living alongside one troop is a dedicated team of researchers whose mission it is to uncover these baboons’ secrets and understand what makes them who they are.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為你介紹一隻非常特別的猴子 - 麥當娜。她是有史以來第一隻從出生到成年直至現在都在學習的金達狒狒,關鍵的是,她正在尋找伴侶。金達狒狒最近才被確定為一個物種,牠們鮮為人知亦不為人理解。但麥當娜正在幫助改變這情況。她可能抓住解開金達狒狒獨特兩性關係秘密的關鍵。這些狒狒獨一無二。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet Madonna, a very special monkey. She’s the first Kinda baboon ever to be studied from birth to adulthood and now, critically, she’s looking for a mate. Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda’s unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力: 群體的生存。但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事。一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲。一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶。一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠。這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.programme_title_tc: 巨象同盟: 長牙兄弟情
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象: 克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃。深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world’s largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」。本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the ‘arribada’, or ‘arrival’. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚、虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅。讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿、怪誕的生存策略。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力: 群體的生存。但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frog’s eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞的捕獲隊伍前往索馬里邊境捕獲50隻被稱為亨氏牛羚的珍稀瀕危羚羊。在過去十年中,亨氏牛羚的數量一直急劇下降,保育組織知道通過捕獲並將它們置於受保護的零捕獵者保育區,有助數量回升。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capture teams from Kenya head to Somali border to capture 50 rare and endangered antelope called a hirola. The hirola numbers have been plummeting over the last decade, and conservation groups know that by capturing and placing them into a protected predator-free conservancy they will rebound.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鵝聚集在水邊,準備在岸上進行危險的旅程。面對前路的險途,數量多比較安全。這些小企鵝有著重要的任務,繁殖的時候到了,牠們必須在雌性到來前找到一個洞穴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭的西岸不像世上任何地方。從冰川覆蓋的山脈到原始雨林,再到嚴酷的寒冷海域,壯麗景致令人難以置信。這片與世隔絕幾乎未被觸及的桃花園,隱藏著許多土生的動物。進化的漂流者,每一個都是罕見的生態瑰寶。從啄羊鸚鵡和害羞的企鵝到哺乳類般的鷸鴕和古老的鰻魚,為了於這種條件下生存,這裡的野生動物必須堅強,狡猾和足智多謀。沿著西岸的旅程讓你窺見這片美地,以及生活在這裡的野生動物的考驗和磨難。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭有兩個野生堡壘保護脆弱的土生動物: 一個是受到鹽水護城河保護的偏遠島嶼,另一個是被防捕食者屏障包圍的山頂城堡。這是這些精緻的庇護所和在其中茁壯成長的動物的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光。牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖。但因惡劣的地形、無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難。只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名。尤以不會飛的鳥類、古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界。這裡有微型的怪物、小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命。每個獵人也是獵物﹐永遠需要努力生存。走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活。從巨型肉食蜈蚣和夜行蟋蟀到捕魚蛛和使用絲質陷阱的發光蠕蟲。奇怪而奇妙,這些無名英雄是野性紐西蘭最令人毛骨悚然的爬行類。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道。在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅。就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡。但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種。這些主要被稱為牲畜、負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered “pests.” But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they’re not welcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用。這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因。保護族群才能賴以生存。對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it’s the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕。冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配。一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒。大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子。三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季。跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存。被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己。馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里。每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜。看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母。為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕。冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配。一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒。大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子。三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季。跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存。被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己。馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里。每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜。看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母。為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象傳奇有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在整個非洲,97%的黑犀牛因其角而被殺死.1997年,該物種在尚比亞被宣布正式絕種.但現在,由於雄心勃勃的重新引入計劃,牠們又回來了.偷獵並沒有消失 - 牠們的角在亞洲醫藥中仍然很珍貴.但一個專責小組正在努力保護牠們的安全.這是保育的前線 - 但它前所未有地困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away – their horns are still...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animals environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處非洲南部海岸的阿爾哥亞灣,是該大陸唯一的企鵝避難所.跟企鵝一起求生,牠們勇於接受難以容忍的因素,以建立一個不可能的海洋社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and host...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​讓時間凝結,見證水在地球最冰冷的生態系中,如何化為改變的力量.與北極熊一同獵捕毫無防備的海豹,與獼猴在天然的溫泉中沐浴取暖,並體驗北極狐那獨特而靈巧的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earths most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹.這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀.在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所.善於交際的織布鳥,綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器,枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體,以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在整個非洲,97%的黑犀牛因其角而被殺死.1997年,該物種在尚比亞被宣布正式絕種.但現在,由於雄心勃勃的重新引入計劃,牠們又回來了.偷獵並沒有消失 - 牠們的角在亞洲醫藥中仍然很珍貴.但一個專責小組正在努力保護牠們的安全.這是保育的前線 - 但它前所未有地困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away – their horns are still...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一隻雞穿梭整個美國,並到英國拜訪一個棲居於花園的老鼠家族.正所謂以毒攻毒,見證人們如何在蜘蛛的幫助下克服蜘蛛恐懼症,與守護著地球上最後兩隻北部白犀牛的志願者同行,並為更多跨物種的友情而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spiders help, trek with the guardian of Earths last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解鸚鵡和鴨嘴獸如何讓人發展出新事業,並窺視一個讓人類和大象終身相伴的共同創傷.本集還會拜訪35歲的火雞兀鷹喬治,並見證一場與袋鼠的道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探塔斯馬尼亞惡魔的溫柔一面,與一隻具冒險精神的海龜相遇,並與小鹿一起享受家庭聚餐.與800公斤的公牛斯普德踢足球,了解貓頭鷹迪格在保育者尼格爾的癌症治療期間,如何為他帶來安慰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Tasmanian devils softer side, meet a pioneering sea turtle, and enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer. Play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull and learn how Digger the owl soothed conservationist Nigel during his cancer treatment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起見證南極洲的巴布亞企鵝用一塊石頭表示愛意,走訪馬達加斯加看看狐猴如何利用有毒的千足蟲來擊退害蟲.齊來跟紅鸛學習化妝技巧,並看看蜜蜂獾展示開鎖技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來到在伯利茲的「海灘銀行」,見證寄居蟹有序排隊,以我們最歷史悠久的貨幣--貝殼進行交易.然後走訪塞內加爾,探望黑猩猩和他的寵物麝貓.見證一隻水獺如何以「人質」換來免費午餐,並到雨林中與切葉蟻們的一起收割.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimps pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一隻雞穿梭整個美國,並到英國拜訪一個棲居於花園的老鼠家族.正所謂以毒攻毒,見證人們如何在蜘蛛的幫助下克服蜘蛛恐懼症,與守護著地球上最後兩隻北部白犀牛的志願者同行,並為更多跨物種的友情而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spiders help, trek with the guardian of Earths last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解鸚鵡和鴨嘴獸如何讓人發展出新事業,並窺視一個讓人類和大象終身相伴的共同創傷.本集還會拜訪35歲的火雞兀鷹喬治,並見證一場與袋鼠的道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jack is hired to search for a missing teenage daughter which he traces to a sleazy manager Fords factory and illegal sex recordings. That turns out only the tip of the iceberg...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由於艾略特情緒不穩,機器人先生和達琳嘗試打倒上帝集團.拜斯與白玫對峙.白玫試圖操縱艾略特,而機器人先生則努力想出怎樣幫助艾略特找到自我.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Robot and Darlene attempt to take down the Deus group as Elliot remains unstable. Price faces off with Whiterose. Whiterose tries to manipulate Elliot and Mr. Robot struggles to figure out how to help Elliot find himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場可怕的集體槍擊案發生一年後,一位調查記者來到一個偏遠的鄉村小鎮撰寫一篇週年紀念文章,但很快就意識到這個故事背後有更多不為人知的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One year after a horrific mass shooting, an investigative journalist arrives in a remote country town to write an anniversary piece, but soon realises there is much more to the story than meets the eye.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬汀的調查帶來一系列的發現,把他捲入更深的荒原和旱溪鎮的秘密.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martins investigation leads to a series of revelations that draw him deeper into the scrublands and the secrets of Riversend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著婚禮臨近,麥林和希金斯幫助了一位現代羅賓漢,她以為自己在幫助學校籌集所需物資,卻在不知情的情況下偷竊了違禁藥品.同時,裡克幫助一位退伍軍人克服重返職場的重重困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As their wedding day approaches, Magnum and Higgins help a modern-day Robin Hood who, thinking she was helping a school obtain needed supplies, unknowingly stole illicit drugs. Also, Rick helps a retired soldier with the difficult task of re-enter...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥林和希金斯分別受僱於一對正處於激烈離婚訴訟中的夫妻,去調查對方的黑料.湯瑪斯和希金斯很快就發現自己為了爭奪資源而反目成仇.同時,瑞克和TC調查了一名身份不明男子的死亡事件,並必須將這一消息告知死者疏遠的女兒蘇西·麥迪遜(貝齊·菲利普斯飾演,她是該劇主演扎克瑞·奈頓的妻子).

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth has rapidly gained more magical power, but hes gotten so used to it that his handling has grown sloppy. To teach him a lesson, Yaga forces Seth to wear gloves that prevent magic use and says that if he removes them, hell be expelled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名新加入審判庭的成員注意到德拉古諾夫隊長的態度似乎相當漫不經心,他不明白為何手下對他如此信任.他加入審判庭的初衷是想與危險的巫師戰鬥,而不是處理一些雜務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A new recruit in the Inquisition notices that Captain Dragunovs attitude seems quite careless, and he cant understand why his men have such faith in him. He joined the Inquisition hoping to fight dangerous sorcerers, not handle odd jobs.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: His assistant in gun related coma, guilt stricken private investigator Jack Taylor leaves Galway for Dublin where he helps a young girl whose mother has been murdered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑克受僱於臭名昭彰的瑪達倫洗衣店的一名前囚犯的女兒,查出一名前修女的身份,她以折磨女孩為樂而臭名遠播,只知其名為路西法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jack is hired by the daughter of a former inmate of the infamous Magdalen Laundries to find the identity of a former nun, known only as Lucifer, who was notorious for taking pleasure in torturing the girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地..

epg.programme_title_tc: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
epg.programme_title_en: My Day After Tomorrow IV - So Good To Be Home
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。
第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 性感又時髦的藍心湄, 將節目中化身性感女神, 舉凡女性的私密情慾到美容, 瘦身等話題, 專家為姐姐妹妹分憂解勞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From makeup, skincare, hairstyle, clothing, horoscopes, parenting, to travel, all kinds of fashion-related topics are presented in the program. Pauline Lan leads dozens of professionals and experts across categories to offer the best fashion insights and tips.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《11點熱吵店》透過年輕世代的角度,無論是兩性、職場、人際、時事娛樂等,大談他們最關心、最想發洩、最有意見的熱門話題!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吉布斯仍然沉浸在失去妻女的悲痛之中,但仍幫團隊調查一宗涉及失蹤女孩的案件.吉布斯的人生被徹底改寫的一刻,終於揭曉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Still grieving the loss of his wife and daughter, Gibbs helps the team work a case involving a missing girl. The moment that irrevocably changed Gibbs life is revealed.
